### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>mattn/go-sqlite3 (github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3)</summary>

### [`v1.14.49`](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/releases/tag/v1.14.49): 1.14.49

[Compare Source](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/compare/v1.14.48...v1.14.49)

#### What's Changed

- Release vtable and cursor handles when SQLite destroys them by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1429](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1429)
- Do not clobber SQLite's default cost estimates in BestIndex by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1430](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1430)
- Translate SQL NULL filter arguments to nil like goVUpdate by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1431](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1431)
- Identify updated row by argv 0 in goVUpdate by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1432](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1432)
- Ignore Used for constraints SQLite marked not usable by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1433](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1433)
- Reject nil module and nil BestIndex result by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1434](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1434)
- Fail upgrade tool on download and write errors by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1435](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1435)
- Fix off-by-one truncating SQL in fuzz target by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1436](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1436)
- Fix wrong results and cursor state sharing in series example by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1437](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1437)
- Use the table name from xCreate args in vtable example by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1438](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1438)
- Close leaked rows in hook example by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1439](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1439)
- Close prepared statement and fail if limit is not enforced in limit example by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1440](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1440)
- Upgrade SQLite to version [`3053004`](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/commit/3053004) by [@​mattn](https://github.com/mattn) in [#​1442](https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1442)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/compare/v1.14.48...v1.14.49>

</details>
